Medium-high gain overdrive with 3 band EQ and external clipping diodes Dragons are in preorder and will ship in 2-3 weeks LED clipping overdrive has become a popular choice among guitar players that want a more realistic amp like distortion that doesn’t compress the signal too much. But when LEDs are in an overdrive, they usually light up. There hasn’t really been an overdrive that actually lets you see the LEDs doing their job and react to your playing. The Dragon introduces a new aesthetic to guitar pedals that makes overdrive fun again! The Dragon V2 features a new look, a modified circuit isolating the volume from the tone controls, and reactive clipping LEDs that are flush with the top of the pedal. Inspired by an overdrive that is meant to sound like a cranked Marshall amp, The Dragon is a flexible hard-clipping overdrive with a passive 3 band EQ that can go from a warm boost to bluesy grit to heavy distortion that still retains clarity. The LED clipping diodes create less compression in the signal gain and allow picking dynamics to remain present through the clipping. Mounting the diodes externally means you can see exactly how much of the signal is being clipped and how much of a difference pick attack makes on the overdrive tone. The lighter you pick, the LEDs will flicker less, but as you pick harder, the LEDs will light up brighter and more solid. As the drive knob is turned up, the LEDs will get brighter when the guitar signal is being clipped. There are three LEDs that make up the Dragons flame: The blue LED, the hottest fire, is the power indicator and the start of the flame The yellow and red LED complete the flame and flicker when it is clipping a guitar signal The 3 band EQ is very similar to the kind found in many classic tube amps and has a small mid scoop around 1Khz with all the controls at noon. This EQ is very versatile and can be tweaked to suit almost any tone. The Dragon also sounds great on bass and retains low end to get a growly full range distortion The Dragon is made using high quality components, like Gørva knobs, heavy duty soft click footswitches, top mounted Lumberg Jacks, and includes a lifetime warranty. We also use audio grade components like 1% metal film resistors and Silver Mica and Wima capacitors Runs on +9v center negative ONLY!
